    jax-cpu = ['jax', 'jaxlib', 'flax', 'optax', 'orbax-checkpoint', 'equinox', 'diffrax', 'e3nn-jax', 'numpy']
    """

OVERRIDE = textwrap.dedent(
    """\

    [[override]]
    gate = 'jax-cpu'
    package = 'jax'
    version = '0.11.2'
    reason = 'CPU examples fail on 0.12'

)

SNIPPETS = ['arviz', 'arviz-base', 'arviz-stats', 'arviz-plots', 'numpyro', 'jax', 'numpy', 'matplotlib']
JAX_CPU = ['jax', 'jaxlib', 'flax', 'optax', 'orbax-checkpoint', 'equinox', 'diffrax', 'e3nn-jax', 'numpy']
PINS = tomllib.loads(SAMPLE)["packages"]
CITED = tomllib.loads(SAMPLE)["cited"]


def make_repo(tmp_path, files=None, text=SAMPLE, do_sync=True):
    root = tmp_path / "repo"
    (root / "build").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / "build" / "versions.toml").write_text(text)
    for rel, body in (files or {}).items():
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(textwrap.dedent(body))
    if do_sync:
        versions.sync(root)
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=root, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=root, check=True)
    return root


def flat(argv):
    return " ".join(str(a) for a in argv)


def has_opt(argv, flag, value):
    s = flat(argv)
    return f"{flag} {value}" in s or f"{flag}={value}" in s


def pypi(version, uploaded):
    files = [{"upload_time_iso_8601": uploaded, "upload_time": uploaded[:19],
              "yanked": False, "packagetype": "bdist_wheel"}]
    return {"info": {"version": version}, "releases": {version: files}, "urls": files}


def fake_uv(tmp_path, monkeypatch, stdout="", stderr="", code=0):
    bindir = tmp_path / "bin"
    bindir.mkdir()
    log = tmp_path / "uv-argv.json"
    script = bindir / "uv"
    script.write_text(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        #!{sys.executable}
        import json, sys
        argv = sys.argv[1:]
        json.dump(argv, open({str(log)!r}, 'w'))
        out = {stdout!r}
        for flag in ('-o', '--output-file'):
            if flag in argv:
                open(argv[argv.index(flag) + 1], 'w').write(out)
        sys.stdout.write(out)
        sys.stderr.write({stderr!r})
        sys.exit({code})
        """))
    script.chmod(script.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IEXEC)
    monkeypatch.setenv("PATH", f"{bindir}{os.pathsep}{os.environ['PATH']}")
    return log

NEWEST = {**{k: v for k, v in PINS.items()}, "jax": "0.12.0.1", "altair": "6.3.0",
          "plotly": "7.1.0", "optuna": "5.0.0", "great-docs": "0.17.0"}


def drift_fetch(url):
    name = versions.normalize(re.search(r"/pypi/([^/]+)/", url).group(1))
    return pypi(NEWEST.get(name, "1.0"), "2026-10-21T08:00:00Z")


def drift_resolver(calls):
    def resolver(reqs, python_version, cutoff):
        calls.append((list(reqs), python_version, cutoff))
        return {versions.normalize(re.split(r"[=<>!~ ]", r)[0]): PINS[versions.normalize(re.split(r"[=<>!~ ]", r)[0])]
                for r in reqs}
    return resolver
